hypotheses.D0_native_tensor_is_exact: The native state reconstructed through the original tensor reaches fidelity at least 0.9999 everywhere.
hypotheses.D1_semantic_prototype_is_an_answer_actua: On selected held-out-template facts, the oracle relation-answer prototype reaches at least 0.95 answer accuracy but less than 0.80 effect fidelity in every run.
hypotheses.D2_residual_alone_does_not_specify_the_a: Replacing the prototype by the global mean while retaining the exact residual gives at most 0.60 selected answer accuracy in every run.
hypotheses.D3_within_cell_residual_identity_is_not_: Swapping residuals within the same relation-answer cell retains at least 0.90 answer accuracy on selected facts in every run.
hypotheses.D4_residual_identity_is_required_for_pre: Within-cell residual swaps lose at least 0.15 effect fidelity relative to the native state on selected facts in every run.
hypotheses.D5_cross_cell_residuals_are_more_disrupt: Globally shuffled residuals lose at least 0.10 more fidelity than within-cell residual swaps on selected facts in every run.
hypotheses.D6_half_residual_preserves_the_answer: Scaling the exact residual to one half retains at least 0.90 selected answer accuracy in every run.
hypotheses.D7_wrong_answer_prototype_flips_control: Changing only the prototype to the next answer reduces selected accuracy below 0.30 in every run.
hypotheses.D8_rule_and_arbitrary_facts_use_the_same: The selected-versus-unselected gap for within-cell residual-swap fidelity is at most 0.15 in every run.
hypotheses.D9_template_transfer_is_stable: Selected within-cell residual-swap fidelity differs by at most 0.10 across templates in every run.
hypotheses.D10_signal_gate_passes: Every scored cell contains at least 64 effectful examples.
